payload.core_mechanism_summary: Greedy prefix adjustment: iterate months, maintain total previous sum; if inflation exceeds k%, increase total to ceil(current*100/k) (implicitly adding to earlier months) to meet ratio; sum increments.
payload.rationale: Code processes elements sequentially, making greedy minimal adjustments to the prefix to satisfy constraint. The optimality relies on an exchange argument (moving increments to earlier months never increases total sum), characteristic of this subtype.
